name: CODECAVE
tagline: CODECAVE is dark, round, and violet — in that order of importance.
description: CODECAVE is a software delivery studio. Its public surface is a marketing and lead-generation site whose entire job is to turn a visitor into one booked consultation. Six services are offered — Cloud & DevOps, E-Commerce, Autodesk plugins, Automation & AI, HubSpot, and AR & VR — and each is titled by the outcome it produces rather than the technology it uses. The stack is Astro 7, Vue 3 and Tailwind 4, with GSAP for entrance motion, Lenis for smooth scroll and Strapi as the content backend.

logo.notes: Horizontal wordmark is primary (357x110). The chevron glyph is always #5F20FE; wordmark paths are white, so the default pairing is white-on-near-black. Use the black-text variant only on a genuinely light surface and the all-white variant for one-ink printing. Clear space equals the height of the chevron. Known defect carried forward: the artwork predates Satoshi and is drawn in outlined Montserrat Bold — the paths are outlined vector, not live text, and must never be re-typed by hand.

colors.name: Surface primary
colors.usage: the page canvas — near-black, never pure black

colors.name: Heading / body
colors.usage: headings and body text — 17.6:1 on the page

colors.name: Action
colors.usage: links, borders, eyebrows, focus halo — edges and marks only, never a large fill

colors.name: Surface secondary

colors.name: Body secondary

colors.name: Surface quaternary
colors.usage: hairline rules, dividers and card edges

voice.tone: A small senior team talking straight to a decision-maker: first-person plural, present tense, short declaratives. Leads with the business outcome, then names the technology. Confident without superlatives. Risk, cost and ownership are addressed head-on, because reassurance rather than excitement is what the audience is buying.
messagingPillars: Outcome before technology — every service is titled by what it produces, never by its stack.
Risk is named, not hidden — NDA, scope, milestones and outcomes are stated upfront.
One low-friction ask — a free consultation, requested through a single primary action per page.
Evidence over adjectives — every figure carries a named source; nothing is claimed without one.

avoid: exclamation marks outside a single lead-magnet CTA

imagery.style: Dark-ground product photography and flat vector illustration, always composited onto the near-black canvas.
subjects: product screenshots in device mockups or full-bleed
flat vector illustration of delivery and infrastructure
client and team portraits on a dark ground
decorative line-and-glow art: thin violet strokes, concentric orbs, radial gradients fading to transparent
imagery.treatment: Crop everything into the system's large radii — 24px minimum, 44px on feature blocks. Decorative art reads as emitted light rather than as a filled shape. Screenshots keep their own chrome; never add a drop shadow beneath them.
avoid: conventional downward drop shadows under imagery
icons and avatars treated as brand imagery

samples.caption: Concentric orbs — the signature decorative motif
Orb field behind the work-process rail
Long arcs behind the testimonial band
Dense line field behind the FAQ

postureRules: Radius is the loudest brand signal: 8px inputs, 12px icon tiles, 24px default card, 36px article, 44px feature, 64px section panel below 768px, 120px at and above it, pill for every button. A 4px corner does not occur in source.
Depth never comes from contrast. The page is #050505 and a card is #0D0D0F — separation is radius plus a 1px #2E2C33 hairline.
The only shadow points upward: --shadow-section stacks three layers with negative Y offsets seeded from #281470. Cards receive no shadow at all.
Violet lives on edges. #5F20FE never fills a large area; the one violet field is the glow button at #9980FF with #1B0D4E text.
One primary action per page. A long page may repeat the glow button once at the very end, never twice in a viewport.
Section rhythm is asymmetric: 200px of padding above, 120px below. Card padding is bottom-heavy at 2rem 2rem 3rem.
Nothing dims on hover — hover raises contrast. Only :disabled reduces it, to opacity 0.2.
Focus is a violet halo on text inputs (outline:none plus --shadow-input-focus) and a 2px #B19AFE ring everywhere else. Neither may be removed.
There is no light theme. Three light surfaces exist as exceptions and cannot be generalized into one.

Component kit covers: button-glow, button-primary, button-secondary, button-tertiary, button-ghost, button-text, button-link, button-disabled, card, card-article, card-feature, chip, field, checkbox, eyebrow, lead, eyebrow-lead, stat, divider, page-container, section-container.

Motion is short and eased, never bouncy: 150ms cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1) for colour, border and fill changes, 200ms ease for surfaces and shadows, 500ms ease for transform. GSAP entrances run 0.5s on power2.out. Nothing loops and nothing bounces.

The reduced-motion guard is not optional. @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) collapses every animation and transition to 0.01ms, caps iteration count at 1, and forces scroll-behavior: auto — which also disables the Lenis smooth scroll.
Only two breakpoints exist in source: 768px and 1280px. Everything below 768px is single-column, and the section-panel radius flips 64px → 120px at 768px. There is no tablet-specific layout.

Decorative art is stroke-only vector on a transparent ground — concentric orbs and long arcs at 0.05–0.8 opacity, gradient-stroked in #5F20FE, #20EFFE and #391398. It reads as emitted light, never as a filled shape, and only resolves when composited on #050505.
